mcq.q: Which sentence is the best beginning of a paragraph about your house?
mcq.explanation: haadhaa baytii (This is my house) introduces the topic.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً mean?
mcq.explanation: أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً (azraʿu shajara) means: I plant a tree.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ (al-jawwu baarid) means: The weather is cold.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَدِيدٌ is read jadiid and means new.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) mean?
mcq.explanation: طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

mcq.q: When you read a picture, what should you look at first?
mcq.explanation: First look at the whole picture, then at the details.

mcq.q: The sentence ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub says where a cup is. Where is it?
mcq.explanation: ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub means 'on the table there is a cup'.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter خ?
mcq.explanation: The letter خ is called khaa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ mean?
options: In my house there is a kitchen.
mcq.explanation: فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ (fii baytii matbakh) means: In my house there is a kitchen.

mcq.q: What does the little word li- mean in li-Aminata?
mcq.explanation: li- means 'for', so li-Aminata is 'for Amina'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "big"?
mcq.explanation: كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) means big.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "sit down"?
mcq.explanation: اجْلِسْ (ijlis) means sit down.

mcq.q: Which of these Arabic words (in English letters) means 'clouds'?
mcq.explanation: ghaym means clouds.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خُبْزٌ (khubz) mean?
mcq.explanation: خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

mcq.q: What does qawiyy mean?
mcq.explanation: qawiyy means strong.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ is read masaa'u l-khayr and means good evening.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable مَ?
mcq.explanation: مَ is read ma.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "In the kitchen there is a table."
mcq.explanation: فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مُشْمِسٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مُشْمِسٌ is read mushmis and means sunny.

mcq.q: What is imitative speaking?
options: Listening carefully and copying what you hear
mcq.explanation: In imitative speaking we listen to a speaker and copy the sounds, speed and tone.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word الثُّلَاثَاءُ (ath-thulaathaa') mean?
mcq.explanation: الثُّلَاثَاءُ (ath-thulaathaa') means Tuesday.

mcq.q: When you time a friend reading, what matters most?
mcq.explanation: Timing helps pace, but accuracy and smoothness matter most.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
The sun is in the sky.
And the rain is from the sky.
mcq.explanation: وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ (wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i) means: And the rain is from the sky.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "I"?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا (anaa) means I.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "friend"?
mcq.explanation: صَدِيقٌ (sadiiq) means friend.

mcq.q: Which Arabic room word is made from the words ghurfa and nawm?
mcq.explanation: ghurfatu n-nawm means 'the room of sleep', which is the bedroom.

mcq.q: Which is a non-verbal cue?
mcq.explanation: Gestures, facial expressions and body movements are non-verbal cues.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَمَامَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَمَامَ is read amaama and means in front of.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: اُخْرُجْ is read ukhruj and means go out.

mcq.q: What is a class portfolio?
options: A folder of the class's best work
mcq.explanation: A portfolio keeps work together to be shown and reviewed.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table.
In the room there is a bed.
mcq.explanation: فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ mean?
mcq.explanation: اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ (ismii Ahmad) means: My name is Ahmad.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The pen is in the bag."
mcq.explanation: الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

mcq.q: What is meant by reading pace?
options: How fast or slow you read
mcq.explanation: Pace is the speed of reading.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I like food."
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ (uhibbu T-taʿaam) means: I like food.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) mean?
mcq.explanation: طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) means table.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ mean?
mcq.explanation: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ (hal tuhibbu l-mawz?) means: Do you like bananas?

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَا اسْمُكَ؟ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَا اسْمُكَ؟ is read maa ismuka? and means What is your name? (to a boy).

mcq.q: Which describing word matches yad (hand), which is feminine?
mcq.explanation: yad is feminine, so it takes the describing word ending in -a.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ش make?
options: kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
mcq.explanation: The letter ش makes the sound sh as in shop.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable سَ?
mcq.explanation: سَ is read sa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ mean?
options: The lamp is above the table.
The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The pen is in the bag.
mcq.explanation: الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila) means: The lamp is above the table.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ (as-samaku ladhiidh) means: The fish is delicious.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ر make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ر makes the sound a quick rolled r.

mcq.q: Which sentence says 'I clean my teeth'?
mcq.explanation: unadhdhifu means I clean and asnaanii means my teeth.

mcq.q: Which is a good way of caring for household items?
options: Wash cups and plates after use
Leave a knife within reach of small children
mcq.explanation: Cleaning items after use helps them to last and keeps the home safe.

mcq.q: How many forms can an Arabic letter have at most?
options: Four: alone, start, middle and end
mcq.explanation: A joining letter can look different alone, at the start, in the middle and at the end of a word.

mcq.q: What is an inferential question?
options: A question whose answer is stated in the text
A question whose answer is not stated but can be worked out from clues
mcq.explanation: For inferential questions you use clues in the text to work out the answer.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "party"?
mcq.explanation: حَفْلَةٌ (hafla) means party.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ب?
mcq.explanation: The letter ب is called baa.

mcq.q: How is the syllable بِي read?
mcq.explanation: The letter yaa after a kasra makes the vowel long, so بِي is bii.

mcq.q: In which direction is Arabic read?
mcq.explanation: Arabic is read from right to left.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word سَرِيرٌ (sariir) mean?
mcq.explanation: سَرِيرٌ (sariir) means bed.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word عَمٌّ (ʿamm) mean?
mcq.explanation: عَمٌّ (ʿamm) means father's brother.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a good ending for a paragraph about your room?
mcq.explanation: uhibbu ghurfatii (I like my room) gives a closing feeling.

mcq.q: What is the difference between ف (faa) and ق (qaaf)?
options: faa has two dots above and qaaf has one
faa has one dot above and qaaf has two dots above
mcq.explanation: Only the dots separate these two letters.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word فِي (fii) mean?
mcq.explanation: فِي (fii) means in.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is my house."
mcq.explanation: هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

mcq.q: Which question do you ask when you point to a boy and want to know who he is?
mcq.explanation: haadhaa means 'this' for a boy or man. haadhihi is used for a girl or woman.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "fruit"?
mcq.explanation: فَاكِهَةٌ (faakiha) means fruit.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ (ʿindii akh wa ukht) means: I have a brother and a sister.

mcq.q: What does tone mean in public speaking?
options: How your voice sounds, for example friendly and clear
mcq.explanation: Tone is the sound quality of your voice, such as calm, friendly and clear.

mcq.q: Which word do you add to an instruction to make it polite?
mcq.explanation: min fadlika means 'please'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَيْضٌ (bayd) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَيْضٌ (bayd) means eggs.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "beautiful"?
mcq.explanation: جَمِيلٌ (jamiil) means beautiful.

mcq.q: What goes on the back of a vocabulary flashcard?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic word is on the front. The back shows the sound and the meaning.

mcq.q: When reciting a poem, what should your actions do?
options: Match the meaning of the words
Show something different from the words
mcq.explanation: Actions must match the words to help the audience understand.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "neck"?
mcq.explanation: رَقَبَةٌ (raqaba) means neck.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا بَيْتِي mean?
options: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ (ummii tatbukhu T-taʿaam) means: My mother cooks the food.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ mean?
options: And the rain is from the sky.
In the room there is a bed.
The sun is in the sky.
mcq.explanation: الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ (ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i) means: The sun is in the sky.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ يَدِي mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ يَدِي (haadhihi yadii) means: This is my hand.

mcq.q: Which greeting fits when you meet someone in the evening?
mcq.explanation: masaa'u l-khayr means 'good evening'. sabaahu l-khayr is for the morning.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word سُكَّرٌ (sukkar) mean?
mcq.explanation: سُكَّرٌ (sukkar) means sugar.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ي?
mcq.explanation: The letter ي is called yaa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word جِسْمٌ (jism) mean?
mcq.explanation: جِسْمٌ (jism) means body.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

mcq.q: Which letter has three dots above it?
mcq.explanation: Thaa has three dots above. Baa has one dot below and taa has two dots above.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "plate"?
mcq.explanation: صَحْنٌ (sahn) means plate.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My grandfather is old (big in age)."
mcq.explanation: جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ (jaddii kabiir) means: My grandfather is old (big in age).

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'The wind is strong'?
mcq.explanation: riih is wind and qawiyya is the feminine form of strong.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The chair is at the door."
mcq.explanation: الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab) means: The chair is at the door.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "chair"?
mcq.explanation: كُرْسِيٌّ (kursii) means chair.

mcq.q: Which word do you say to tell a friend it is now their turn?
mcq.explanation: dawruka means 'your turn'. dawrii means 'my turn'.

mcq.q: How does a reading circle work?
options: Each learner takes a turn to read aloud
One learner reads for the whole hour
mcq.explanation: In a reading circle each learner reads in turn.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (maa ismuka?) mean?
options: What is your name? (to a boy)
mcq.explanation: مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (maa ismuka?) means What is your name? (to a boy).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أَخٌ (akh) mean?
mcq.explanation: أَخٌ (akh) means brother.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter س make?
options: kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
mcq.explanation: The letter س makes the sound s as in sun.

mcq.q: How do you read the shadda in the word jad-dun?
options: The letter daal is said twice
mcq.explanation: A shadda doubles the letter, so jadd has two d sounds.

mcq.q: Which is a good way of reducing food waste?
options: Take only what you can eat
mcq.explanation: Taking only what you can eat and saving leftovers reduces waste.

mcq.q: How is the syllable بُ read?
mcq.explanation: The mark Damma gives the vowel u, so بُ is bu.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cold."
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ (al-jawwu baarid) means: The weather is cold.

mcq.q: What is a paragraph?
options: A group of sentences about one idea
mcq.explanation: A paragraph is a group of related sentences about one idea.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Water is useful (good for you)."
mcq.explanation: الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "drink"?
mcq.explanation: شَرَابٌ (sharaab) means drink.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable مِ?
mcq.explanation: مِ is read mi.

mcq.q: Which ending shows that you are speaking to a boy?
mcq.explanation: The ending -ka is used when speaking to a boy or man, as in kayfa haaluka?

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "dance"?
mcq.explanation: رَقْصٌ (raqs) means dance.

mcq.q: How do you ask a boy how old he is?
mcq.explanation: kam means 'how many' and ʿumruka means 'your age', so kam ʿumruka? asks 'How old are you?'.
